interpretationBoundaries.rhnaRule: HCD permit progress is official; completion comparisons are supplemental
interpretationBoundaries.timelineMatching: exact jurisdiction + tracking ID, then exact jurisdiction + APN; no fuzzy or address matching
interpretationBoundaries.zoningRule: mapped category composition is not legal development capacity

limitations: Application, entitlement, permit, and completion records are annual stage flows, not one cohort; the interface does not present them as a conversion funnel.
Timeline medians describe only deterministic exact-ID matches. Match coverage and sample sizes are published, unmatched records are not imputed, and the results are not population estimates.
APR data are submitted by local jurisdictions and can be revised. A record is not always a unique project, and application-status fields are sparsely populated before 2021.
California tracks RHNA progress with issued building permits. Completion counts are a supplemental descriptive comparison and do not establish official RHNA credit.
Table C is conditionally reported for specified shortfall and no-net-loss circumstances. No reported rows do not prove that no rezoning occurred.
The statewide zoning inventory combines local data of varying vintages and methods. Its broad classes and polygon areas do not establish parcel-level legality, feasibility, or housing capacity.
Housing-element compliance is a current administrative snapshot and can change between refreshes; it is not a historical compliance series.
ADU records use HCD's reported unit category and stage fields; permits authorize construction and completions indicate a reported final stage, not occupancy.
